coverageNotes.2027: 2027 Chevrolet: 1 manufacturer-source-verified standard-equipment guide, 6 configurations. Missing technical specifications remain Unverified. Color references are not inventory claims.

vehicles.summary: Audited 2026 RAV4 Hybrid guide: six grades and nine FWD/AWD configurations. Brochure Standard/Available marks are preserved; published maximum torque and HEV-only applicability are clarified. Unresolved ratings and unexplained equipment blanks retain specific audit reasons.

sources.title: Toyota 2026 RAV4 brochure — supplied PDF, 30 pages; HEV grade/equipment tables pp. 17–25, package caveat p. 30
sources.fileName: rav4_ebrochure.pdf
sources.scope: HEV tables only. Manufacturer link is the official model page, not a claim that this PDF was downloaded from that URL. Data-quality audit rechecked every previously Unverified HEV cell; maximum torque is quoted with unspecified basis. Plug-in-specific fields are classified not applicable to HEV, not inferred from blank matrix entries.

engine.value: Hybrid: 2.5L Dynamic Force four-cylinder with Toyota Hybrid System

torque.value: Brochure-listed maximum: 170 lb-ft (231 N·m); torque basis not specified
torque.conditions: Toyota brochure p. 25 marks this maximum S on all six HEV grades. It does not identify engine-only or combined-system torque. The release’s 163/172 lb-ft engine figures are not treated as equivalent metrics; do not sum motor and engine torque.

transmission.value: Electronically controlled continuously variable transmission (ECVT) with sequential shift mode

economy.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 6–7, 17–18, 25): The supplied brochure contains no configuration-specific fuel-economy ratings. The reviewed Toyota release has conflicting HEV estimates, and the EPA lookup is blocked by the proxy. Do not select a convenient number or label a manufacturer estimate EPA-certified.

towing.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 6, 26): Only the general up-to-3,500-lb headline appears in the brochure; the reviewed release does not establish this FWD configuration’s limit. A 900-lb example shown in footnote 12 is not a tow rating. The detailed Toyota specification PDF is blocked.

wheels.value: 17-inch dark gray metallic alloy wheels

appearance.value: Core design; color-keyed grille; low-profile roof rails; LED projector headlights

roof.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 20–21): This trim’s moonroof entries are blank in the HEV S/A matrix. The legend defines S and A but does not define blank as an explicit not-offered symbol. No negative availability claim is established by another reviewed source.

seating.value: 60/40 split reclining fold-flat rear seat; total seating capacity remains Unverified in the reviewed sources

upholstery.value: Fabric; manual 6-way front seats

heatedSeats.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 22): The LE seat row confirms fabric/manual seats, but neither that text nor the unexplained blank explicitly states front-seat heating is not offered. Do not infer absence from another trim’s heated-seat row.

ventilatedSeats.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 22): The trim’s seat row does not establish ventilation; the ventilation rows/marks apply to other named grades. No explicit negative availability statement was found for this configuration.

heatedWheel.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 21–22): LE has a standard urethane steering-wheel row, while the heated-wheel row is blank for LE. The brochure does not explicitly define that blank as not offered; another trim’s heated/leather wheel cannot establish LE availability.

infotainment.value: 10.5-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia

instruments.value: 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster

audio.value: 6 speakers

phone.value: Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

assistance.value: Backup camera with dynamic gridlines; Hill Start Assist; Trailer-Sway Control

safety.value: Toyota Safety Sense 4.0; eight airbags; Star Safety System; Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert and Safe Exit Alert; TPMS

electricRange.value: Not applicable — this is the conventional HEV, not a plug-in hybrid electric-range rating
electricRange.conditions: Classification-based not-applicable entry, not an inference from a blank equipment cell. The supplied brochure distinguishes Hybrid and externally charged PHEV powertrains on p. 15 and identifies these configurations as HEV on pp. 17–18/25. HEV EV Mode still allows short, low-speed electric operation under limited conditions (footnote 61); no zero-mile range is invented.

charging.value: Not applicable — conventional HEV powertrain; plug-in charging belongs to the separate PHEV system
charging.conditions: Classification-based not-applicable entry, not an inference from a blank equipment cell. The supplied brochure distinguishes Hybrid and externally charged PHEV powertrains on p. 15 and identifies these configurations as HEV on pp. 17–18/25. HEV EV Mode still allows short, low-speed electric operation under limited conditions (footnote 61); no zero-mile range is invented.

dcCharging.value: Not applicable — conventional HEV, not an externally charged plug-in powertrain
dcCharging.conditions: Classification-based not-applicable entry, not an inference from a blank equipment cell. The supplied brochure distinguishes Hybrid and externally charged PHEV powertrains on p. 15 and identifies these configurations as HEV on pp. 17–18/25. HEV EV Mode still allows short, low-speed electric operation under limited conditions (footnote 61); no zero-mile range is invented.

wirelessCharging.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 23): LE/SE wired USB-C ports are documented, but their Qi charger entries are blank. Wired charging does not establish either presence or explicit exclusion of wireless charging.

headUpDisplay.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 18, 21): The brochure confirms the Limited HUD option but supplies no explicit availability/exclusion statement for this trim. No transfer of the Limited option is assumed.

cargoOutlet.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 23): Woodland’s 120V/1,500W outlet is explicit; this trim’s corresponding cell is blank. Standard 12V outlets do not establish the availability or exclusion of the different AC outlet.

advancedAssistance.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 24): The FCTA/LCA/TJA/Driver Monitor row has no S/A mark for LE/SE. Standard TSS 4.0 is separately verified and must not be confused with this additional group. No explicit not-offered definition applies to blank entries.

parkingAutomation.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 24): Advanced Park is explicitly A for XSE and S for Limited. Other grades are blank, without a defined negative symbol or an explicit exclusion. Parking Assist with Automatic Braking is a different feature and remains verified separately.

liftgate.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 20): LE’s power-liftgate entries are blank. The SE available and higher-grade standard entries do not verify LE availability or an explicit exclusion.

areaView.conditions: No independent surround-view availability or exclusion is established by the retained configuration-specific evidence. A standard rearview camera is not a surround-view camera.

adaptiveCruiseControl.value: Full-Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control (DRCC), part of Toyota Safety Sense 4.0
adaptiveCruiseControl.conditions: Adaptive cruise category; Toyota-specific system and operating limits retained. Driver supervision required. This is not Traffic Jam Assist or autonomous driving.

panoramicRoof.conditions: No configuration-specific panoramic-roof availability or explicit exclusion in retained evidence. Conventional moonroof availability does not establish a panoramic roof.

gains.text: Gain 19-inch wheels, Leatherette & CloudTex, power driver seat, remote start, power liftgate and 10-color ambient lighting; panoramic sunroof becomes optional.
Gain 20-inch wheels, standard panoramic sunroof, black roof rails, illuminated door handles, stainless steel pedals, leather steering wheel and frameless auto-dimming mirror.

For 4MOTION: gain 268 hp / 258 lb-ft, Varenna leather, ventilated/massage front seats, rear outboard heating, 15-inch display, Harman Kardon audio, three-zone climate, Area View and Park Assist Plus; highway MPG changes from 30 to 29. Heated steering wheel has delayed availability. Silver roof rails replace black rails.

notes: VW-P: preliminary pricing/equipment, 3 pages; VW-T: final v2 technical specifications, 2 pages. Both downloaded and reviewed 2026-11-04. The pricing sheet has no printed publication/effective date; PDF metadata is not treated as an effective price date.
MSRP excludes $1,475 destination; each configuration shows base MSRP and the arithmetic total including destination. Pricing, equipment and specifications are subject to change.

Each equipment column was reviewed independently. S = standard, O = optional, dash = not offered in that equipment row; X identifies eligible option-package trims. Unexplained blanks are not treated as proof of absence. S has silver roof rails; SE R-Line Black has a frameless auto-dimming mirror, both positively marked in their own rows.

Fuel economy is quoted as Volkswagen-published consumption, not independently verified EPA records. FWD S: 26/34/29; other FWD: 25/32/28; non-Turbo 4MOTION: 22/30/25; Turbo 4MOTION: 22/29/25 MPG (city/highway/combined).
Cargo volumes are footnoted by Volkswagen as based on third-party testing. Headroom is retained both with and without sunroof; passenger volume is specified without sunroof only.

Earlier two-PDF review (before this order-guide import): Genuine gaps: SE R-Line Black curb weight is not specified (technical sheet lists S/SE only); head-up display and cargo AC outlet availability are not established; SEL 15-inch infotainment row does not itemize radio/Bluetooth/USB features bundled in the separate 12.9-inch row. No equipment carryover is assumed.

SEL R-Line Turbo is 4MOTION-only; no FWD record or invented price is created. Heated steering wheel/paddle shifters are listed standard with delayed availability. Confirm actual window sticker and production date.

Bulk order-guide import: 2025-10-09, reviewed 2026-11-04. Every equipment-table row is recorded separately by configuration. Factory packages, paint charges, market-delivery options and services retain distinct descriptions and restrictions. MSRP excludes destination. ID.4 prices marked TBA remain Unverified. Missing measurements require technical specifications. Original supplied PDF is not republished. Manufacturer source link is not a PDF download URL.

Gain 20-inch wheels, moonroof, hands-free liftgate, Ultrasuede/SofTex with power front seats and driver memory, front-seat ventilation, 12.9-inch screen and 3D Panoramic View Monitor. Head-up display and cargo outlet are optional; packages unverified.

Choose a rugged PHEV AWD alternative with all-terrain tires, hitch/wiring, raised rails/crossbars, heated steering wheel and cargo AC outlet. Gain 11-kW/CCS1 DC charging; manufacturer-estimated EV range changes from 52 to 49 miles. Named packages and conflicting Woodland MPG remain unverified.
Choose the handling-focused PHEV AWD: GR-tuned suspension/steering, functional aero, 20-inch wheels, bolstered Brin Naub/SofTex sport seats, heated steering wheel and 12.9-inch screen.
GR SPORT retains 7-kW/J1772 AC-only charging; it does not gain XSE/Woodland DC charging. Manufacturer-estimated EV range is 48 miles. Do not treat GR SPORT as a universal equipment upgrade over XSE.

notes: Detailed PHEV specifications and package contents are awaiting separate documentation. The supplied 30-page RAV4 brochure equipment matrix covers six HEV grades, not these PHEV configurations. No HEV brochure equipment or packages have been copied here.
Only claims expressly supported by Toyota’s 2026 release are recorded. Missing fields remain Unverified; known release details do not make this a complete PHEV equipment guide.

The release conflicts on Woodland PHEV MPG (37 or 38 combined) and GR SPORT MPG (36 or 37 combined); those MPG cells remain Unverified. Displayed SE/XSE MPG and PHEV electric ranges are manufacturer estimates, not verified EPA ratings.

All four PHEVs are AWD with 324 net combined system hp. The 172 lb-ft figure is gasoline-engine-only. SE/GR SPORT use 7-kW/J1772 AC-only charging; XSE/Woodland use 11-kW/CCS1 with DC capability. Actual charging time and range vary.
Source-specific equipment and optional items are not a factory-package manifest. Confirm the actual vehicle window sticker and owner’s manual. Driver supervision and subscription conditions apply.

items.text: Volkswagen identifies the 2027 Atlas as ALL NEW. Output changes from 269 hp / 273 lb-ft to 282 hp / 258 lb-ft; the higher horsepower is accompanied by lower quoted torque.
The listed lineup is now SE, SE w/ Technology, SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line®. Atlas Peak Edition and the plain SEL name from 2026 are not listed in this edition.
The standard 12-inch center display is replaced by a 12.9-inch display on SE and a 15-inch display on SE w/ Technology and above. Dual front Qi chargers replace the single front charger.

SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line® add active ventilation for outboard second-row seats; 2026 documented rear heating without ventilation. New Varenna/Nappa upholstery choices, real wood décor and revised ambient lighting are detailed by trim.
Front/rear Park Distance Control and hands-free Easy Open/Easy Close are now standard even on SE; both were unavailable on 2026 SE.

Travel Assist adds assisted lane changing and Emergency Assist becomes Emergency Assist Plus. SEL Premium R-Line® adds Park Assist Plus with Memory Parking; the new seven-airbag protection system is documented across trims.
The SE w/ Technology Black Wheel Package changes from 20-inch 40T wheels to 54U wheels; the 2027 package carries limited availability ending CW02/27.

gaps: Volkswagen labels the model ALL NEW; the order guide does not establish new exterior/interior measurements or fuel economy. The p. 5 photo caption still mentions Atlas Peak Edition, although that trim is absent from the configuration and equipment tables. Confirm any later trim release separately.

caveats.text: Order guide 2026-09-28; pricing excludes destination; missing ratings/measurements and TBA prices remain Unverified. Full configuration-specific equipment, packages and source pages are in the online guide.

items.text: Volkswagen identifies the 2027 Atlas Cross Sport as ALL NEW. Output changes from 269 hp / 273 lb-ft to 282 hp / 258 lb-ft.
SE and SE w/ Technology retain FWD/AWD listings, followed by AWD SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line®. The 2026 plain SEL and SEL R-Line® Black names are no longer listed.
The 12-inch center display is replaced by 12.9 inches on SE and 15 inches on higher trims. Dual front Qi chargers replace the single front charger.

SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line® now document heated and actively ventilated outboard rear seats, plus Varenna/Nappa upholstery and revised interior lighting. The 2026 table documented rear heating without ventilation.

SE gains standard front/rear Park Distance Control and hands-free Easy Open/Easy Close, previously unavailable on SE. Assisted lane changing, Emergency Assist Plus and a seven-airbag system are documented; SEL Premium R-Line® adds Memory Parking.

items.text: SE R-Line® Black gains a standard heated steering wheel; the 2026 equipment matrix marked it not offered on that trim. The 2027 production credit 2PD can remove steering-wheel heating, so verify the actual window sticker.
The driver-assistance table now names Emergency Assist Plus instead of Emergency Assist.

gaps: The PJ2 wheel package still has conflicting wheel codes: U24 on p. 13 versus 48H on p. 16. Confirm the correct code with Volkswagen. Detailed 2027 fuel economy and measurements are not supplied; 2026 technical values have not been copied.

caveats.text: Order guide 2026-09-28; pricing excludes destination; missing ratings/measurements and TBA prices remain Unverified. Full configuration-specific equipment, packages and source pages are in the online guide.

items.text: A new Sport trim is listed in FWD and 4MOTION AWD, between S and SE. Its equipment includes GOAL-pattern cloth with yellow contrast stitching, black exterior accents and drivetrain-specific black wheels.
S gains standard MIB3 Composition Media and a six-speaker sound system. The 2026 S listing used Composition Color and did not offer the six-speaker system.

gaps: The SE FWD P35 wheel option from 2026 is not listed in the 2027 factory option table; absence from this non-exhaustive guide is not confirmation of discontinuation. Technical measurements, fuel economy and a tow rating require additional documentation.

caveats.text: Order guide 2026-09-28; pricing excludes destination; missing ratings/measurements and TBA prices remain Unverified. Full configuration-specific equipment, packages and source pages are in the online guide.

items.text: Golf R Black Edition is newly listed beside Golf R. Its documented standard distinctions include gloss-black 19-inch wheels, black badging/logos and black exhaust tips.

Akrapovič titanium exhaust is now a standalone factory option 0P8 for either trim. The 2026 guide bundled it in Euro Style Package POA. The POA roof/ventilation deletion package is not listed in this edition; do not label the retained standard roof and ventilated seats as newly added equipment.
Travel Assist adds assisted lane changing and the standard suite names Emergency Assist Plus instead of Emergency Assist.

gaps: The guide does not expressly confirm discontinuation of Euro Style Package POA; its absence is a listing change. Detailed 2027 fuel economy and technical measurements remain unresolved.

caveats.text: Order guide 2026-09-28; pricing excludes destination; missing ratings/measurements and TBA prices remain Unverified. Full configuration-specific equipment, packages and source pages are in the online guide.

items.text: Push-button engine start is now standard on S and Sport as well as SE and SEL; the 2026 table marked S and Sport not offered.
S and Sport now receive MIB3 Composition Media instead of Composition Color. SE and SEL retain their documented systems rather than being labeled new.
The 2027 guide explicitly marks the front/rear seatbelt reminder system NEW and standard on every trim; it was not listed in the reviewed 2026 equipment table.

gaps: Unlisted 2026 seatbelt-reminder equipment is not treated as proven absence; this change follows the explicit 2027 NEW label. Technical measurements and 2027 fuel economy require additional documentation.
The p. 35 JDD Dynamic Center Caps retail amount is printed as $22, while comparable entries elsewhere in the guide are $228. The $22 source value is retained; manufacturer confirmation is needed.

items.text: The 2027 configuration table lists Autobahn with seven-speed DSG only; the 2026 table listed both six-speed manual and DSG. Do not carry the manual configuration into 2027 from the previous year.
The front/rear seatbelt reminder system is explicitly marked NEW and standard in the 2027 guide. No 2026 absence is inferred from its omission in that table.

gaps: The p. 38 illustration caption still says manual although the priced table lists only DSG. Manual availability requires Volkswagen clarification; the caption is not used to invent a configuration. The 2026 projector-headlamp description is absent from the 2027 table, so removal is not claimed. Fuel economy and technical measurements require the 2027 specifications.

loss of control. See Owner’s Manual for additional limitations and details. 98. Extra-cost color. 99. The backup camera does not provide a comprehensive
view of the rear area of the vehicle/trailer. When using straight path assist, driver should confirm clearance and is still responsible for safe operation. See
Owner’s Manual for limitations. 100. Integrated Trailer Brake Controller is an electronic system that operates in tandem with a trailer equipped with an
electric braking system. It is designed to help the driver maintain trailer control by increasing or reducing trailer braking based on trailer weight. It is not a
substitute for safe towing practices. Factors including speed, weather, road conditions and driver input can all affect trailer braking control. See Owner's
Manual for additional limitations and details. 101. Front and rear parking assist sonar is designed to warn drivers of potential front and rear collisions with
certain objects at low speeds. Drivers should visually confirm clearance during use. See Owner’s Manual for instructions and limitations. 102. Front and Rear
Parking Assist with Automatic Braking (PA w/AB) may warn drivers of, and potentially brake for front and rear collisions with certain objects when traveling
at low speeds. Drivers should visually confirm clearance during use. See Owner’s Manual for instructions and limitations. 103. The Pedestrian Detection
system is designed to detect a pedestrian ahead of the vehicle, determine if impact is imminent and help reduce impact speed. It is not a substitute for safe
and attentive driving. System effectiveness depends on many factors, such as speed, size and position of pedestrian, and weather, light and road
conditions. See Owner’s Manual for additional limitations and details. 104. When the system is on, Electric Parking Brake is designed to engage the Parking
Brake under limited conditions. It may not hold the vehicle under all conditions. See Owner’s Manual for additional limitations and details.

INFO AND DISCLOSURES

(LTA) are activated. Do not overly rely on this system. Driver must confirm lane is clear. See Owner's Manual for limitations. 80. Traffic Jam Assist is not an
automated driving system, requires driver supervision at all times, and is designed to function on controlled access freeways at speeds of 25 mph or less.
Operation requires Lane Tracing Assist to be active. Use this system in accordance with applicable laws. Requires an active subscription to Drive Connect
that depends on 4G network availability and other factors. Service requires account registration through the Toyota app and acceptance of Connected
Services Terms of Use at www.toyota.com/content/dam/toyota/privacyvts/pdf/connected-services-terms-use.pdf and Master Data Consent. Data charges
may apply. Before operating, refer to Owner’s Manual for instructions and limitations. 81. Do not rely exclusively on Safe Exit Alert. Always look for
approaching traffic before exiting the vehicle. See Owner’s Manual for limitations. 82. Vehicle Stability Control is not a substitute for safe and attentive
driving practices. Factors including speed, road conditions, weather and steering input can affect whether VSC will be effective. See Owner’s Manual for
limitations. 83. Smart Stop Technology® will reduce power to help the brakes bring vehicle to a stop during certain contemporaneous brake and accelerator
pedal applications. See Owner's Manual for limitations. 84. The Tire Pressure Monitor System alerts the driver when tire pressure is critically low. For
optimal tire wear and performance, tire pressure should be checked regularly with a gauge; do not rely solely on the monitor system. See Owner's Manual
for limitations and details. 85. When the system is on, Electric Parking Brake is designed to engage the Parking Brake under limited conditions. It may not
hold the vehicle under all conditions. See Owner’s Manual for additional limitations and details.

Toyota strives to build vehicles to match customer interest and thus they typically are built with popular options and option packages. Not all
options/packages are available separately and some may not be available in all regions of the country. See toyota.com for information about
options/packages commonly available in your area. If you would prefer a vehicle without any or with different options, contact your dealer to check for
current availability or the possibility of placing a special order.

or print).
Some vehicles are shown with available equipment. Seatbelts should be worn at all times. For details on vehicle specifications, standard features and
available equipment in your area, contact your Toyota dealer. A vehicle with particular equipment may not be available at the dealership. Ask your Toyota
dealer to help locate a specifically equipped vehicle.
All information presented herein is based on data available at the time of posting, is subject to change without notice and pertains specifically to mainland
U.S.A. vehicles only. Vehicles shown may be prototypes, shown using visual effects and/or shown with options. Actual models may vary.

INFO AND DISCLOSURES


1. Nightshade shown in Karashi. Computer-generated images shown. 2. Limited AWD interior shown in Gradient Black SofTex® trim. Vehicle shown with
options. Computer-generated images shown. 3. Limited AWD interior shown in Light Gray SofTex® trim. 4. Limited AWD shown in Cutting Edge.
Computer-generated images shown. 5. Limited AWD interior shown in Gradient Black SofTex® trim. Computer-generated images shown. 6. Nightshade
interior shown in Gradient Black SofTex® trim. Computer-generated images shown. 7. Performance figures are for comparison only and were obtained with
prototype vehicles by professional drivers. 8. EV Mode allows for operation solely on battery power at low speeds for short distances and in limited
circumstances, such as in a parking garage. Different conditions may prevent or limit usage. See your Owner’s Manual for instructions and limitations. 9.
Limited AWD shown in Cutting Edge. 10. EPA-estimated 59 city/50 hwy/55 combined mpg rating for 2027 Prius LE; 56 city/49 hwy/53 combined mpg rating
for 2027 Prius LE AWD; 54 city/46 hwy/51 combined mpg rating for 2027 Prius XLE, Limited and Nightshade Edition; and 51 city/45 hwy/48 combined mpg
rating for 2027 Prius XLE AWD, Limited AWD and Nightshade Edition AWD. Use for comparison purposes only. Your mileage will vary for many reasons,
including your vehicle's condition and how/where you drive. See www.fueleconomy.gov. 11. Cargo and load capacity limited by weight and distribution.
Always properly secure cargo and cargo area. Limited AWD interior shown in Light Gray SofTex® trim. 12. Do not overly rely on Advanced Park and use only
in accordance with applicable laws. Remain attentive to surroundings. Before operating, review Owner’s Manual for instructions and limitations. 13. The
Panoramic View Monitor does not provide a comprehensive view of the area surrounding your vehicle. Look around to confirm clearance. See Owner’s
Manual for limitations. 14. Drive Connect services may vary and are subject to change at any time without notice. Availability and accuracy depend on 4G
network availability, a cellular connection and GPS signal. Without any one or more of these things, operability may be limited or precluded. Further, if and
when 4G network changes or is discontinued, or the underlying technology required to support service becomes obsolete, then services will not work, and
will need to be discontinued. Services require account registration through Toyota app and acceptance of Connected Services Terms of Use at
www.toyota.com/content/dam/toyota/ privacyvts/pdf/connected-services-terms-use.pdf and Master Data Consent. Data charges may apply. For Toyota’s
Connected Services’ vehicle-generated data collection, use, sharing, and retention practices and agreements, see www.toyota.com/support/privacy-notice/.
Trial period begins on original purchase or lease date of new vehicle. Services may vary and are subject to change without notice. Requires app
download/registration, acceptance of Terms of Use and subscription after trial (if applicable). Data charges may apply. 15. Cloud Navigation requires a trial
or subscription to Drive Connect. Drive Connect availability and accuracy depend on certain factors outside of Toyota's control in order to operate, including
4G network availability, a cellular connection and GPS signal. Without any one or more of these things, operability may be limited or precluded. Services
subject to change at any time without notice. Requires app download/registration and subscription after trial (if applicable). Terms of Use apply. Data
charges may apply. See Owner’s Manual and https://www.toyota.com/connected-services/ for limitations. To learn about Toyota's Connected Services data
collection, use, sharing and retention practices, visit https://www.toyota.com/support/privacy-notice/. 16. Wireless charging may not be compatible with all
mobile phones, smart devices, tablets, e-readers, MP3/WMA players and like products. 17. May not be compatible with all mobile phones, smart devices,
tablets, e-readers, MP3/WMA players and like models. 18. Limited AWD shown in Cutting Edge. Simulation shown. 19. Wireless charging may not be
compatible with all mobile phones, smart devices, tablets, e-readers, MP3/WMA players and like products. Wireless use of Android Auto requires a
compatible Android 11.0+ phone and compatible active data plan. Check https://g.co/androidauto/requirements for compatibility. Operability depends on
network availability, a cellular connection, and GPS signal. Services vary by vehicle and are subject to change at any time without notice. Data charges may
apply. To learn more, go to https://www.toyota.com/audio-multimedia/. To learn more about Toyota's Connected Services data collection, use, sharing, and
retention practices, please visit https://www.toyota.com/support/privacy-notice/. Google, Android, Android Auto, Google Maps, and other marks are
trademarks of Google LLC. Compatible Android phone and compatible active data plan required. Limited AWD interior shown in Gradient Black SofTex®
trim. 20. Do not rely exclusively on Blind Spot Monitor. Look over shoulder and use turn signal. See Owner's Manual for limitations. 21. Do not rely
exclusively on the Rear Cross-Traffic Alert. Visually confirm clearance during use. See Owner’s Manual for limitations. 22. The backup camera does not
provide a comprehensive view. Always look over shoulder and use outside mirrors. See Owner's Manual for limitations. 23. Do not rely exclusively on Safe
Exit Alert. Always look for approaching traffic before exiting the vehicle. See Owner’s Manual for limitations. 24. ToyotaCare covers normal factory scheduled
maintenance for 1 year or 10,000 miles, whichever comes first, and 24/7 Roadside Assistance is for 2 years/unlimited mileage, with the following exceptions:
(1) ToyotaCare for Mirai is 3 years/35,000 miles and ToyotaCare for vehicle model years 2026 and earlier is 2 years/25,000 miles; and (2) Roadside
Assistance for Mirai, Prius, Toyota BEVs and PHEVs is 3 years/unlimited mileage. Roadside Assistance does not include parts and fluids, except limited
emergency gas delivery. Towing distance up to 25 miles. Restrictions apply. ToyotaCare valid only in the continental U.S.; Roadside Assistance valid in
continental U.S., Hawaii and Canada. See Toyota dealer for details and exclusions. 25. For Toyota hybrid, plug-in hybrid, fuel cell and battery electric vehicles
beginning model year 2020, the hybrid (HV) battery is covered for 10 years from date of first use or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first. Coverage is
subject to the terms and conditions of your New Vehicle Limited Warranty. See the Toyota Owner’s Warranty and Maintenance Guide for details. 26. Toyota
Safety Sense™effectiveness is dependent on many factors including road, weather and vehicle conditions. Drivers are responsible for their own safe
driving. Always pay attention to your surroundings and drive safely. See Owner’s Manual for limitations. 27. The Pre-Collision System (PCS) with Pedestrian
Detection (PD) is designed to determine if impact is imminent and help reduce impact speed and damage in certain frontal collisions involving a vehicle, a
pedestrian, a bicycle, or a motorcyclist. PCS w/PD is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. System effectiveness depends on many factors, such as
speed, size and position of pedestrian or bicyclist and weather, light and road conditions. See Owner's Manual for limitations. 28. Full-Speed Range Dynamic
Radar Cruise Control is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. See Owner’s Manual for instructions and limitations. 29. Lane Departure Alert with
Steering Assist is designed to read visible lane markers under certain conditions. It provides a visual/audible alert and slight steering force when lane
departure is detected. It is not a collision-avoidance system or a substitute for safe and attentive driving. Effectiveness depends on many factors including
road, weather and vehicle conditions. See Owner’s Manual for limitations. 30. The Lane Tracing Assist (LTA) lane centering function is designed to read
visible lane markers and detect other vehicles under certain conditions. It is only operational when DRCC is engaged. See Owner's Manual for limitations.
31. Dynamic Radar Cruise Control is not a substitute for safe and attentive driving. See Owner’s Manual for limitations. 32. Road Sign Assist only recognizes
certain road signs. See Owner’s Manual for limitations. 33. Automatic High Beams operate at speeds above 21 mph. See Owner’s Manual for instructions

sourcePageNotes.text:
INFO AND DISCLOSURES


1. EPA-estimated 52 city/49 hwy/51 combined mpg rating for 2026 Camry LE; 50 city/49 hwy/50 combined mpg rating for 2026 Camry LE AWD; 47 city/45
hwy/46 combined mpg rating for 2026 Camry SE, XLE and XSE; 46 city/46 hwy/46 combined mpg rating for 2026 Camry SE AWD and XLE AWD; 43
city/43 hwy/43 combined mpg rating for 2026 Camry XSE AWD. Use for comparison purposes only. Your mileage will vary for many reasons, including
your vehicle’s condition and how/where you drive. See www.fueleconomy.gov. 2. EV Mode lets you operate solely on battery power at low speeds for
short distances and in limited circumstances, such as in a parking garage. Different conditions may prevent or limit usage. See your Owner’s Manual for
instructions and limitations. 3. XLE shown in Ocean Gem. Options shown. 4. XSE shown in Heavy Metal with Midnight Black Metallic roof. Options
shown. 5. Drive Mode Select shown. 6. XSE shown in Wind Chill Pearl. Options shown. 7. Nightshade shown in Supersonic Red. Options shown. 8.
Nightshade interior shown in Black mixed-media trim. 9. XLE shown in Dark Cosmos. Options shown. 10. Wireless charging may not be compatible with
all mobile phones, smart devices, tablets, e-readers, MP3/WMA players and like products. 11. May not be compatible with all mobile phones, smart
devices, tablets, e-readers, MP3/WMA players and like models. 12. XSE interior shown in Cockpit Red leather trim. Options shown. 13. Screen depiction
accurate at time of posting. XLE interior shown in Light Gray leather and Dinamica® microfiber trim. Simulation shown. Options shown. 14. Do not rely
exclusively on Blind Spot Monitor. Look over shoulder and use turn signal. See Owner's Manual for limitations. 15. Do not rely exclusively on the Rear
Cross-Traffic Alert. Visually confirm clearance during use. See Owner’s Manual for limitations. 16. Traffic Jam Assist is not an automated driving system,
requires driver supervision at all times, and is designed to function on controlled access freeways at speeds of 25 mph or less. Operation requires Lane
Tracing Assist to be active. Use this system in accordance with applicable laws. Requires an active subscription to Drive Connect that depends on 4G
network availability and other factors. Service requires account registration through the Toyota app and acceptance of Connected Services Terms of Use
at toyota.com/content/dam/toyota/privacyvts/pdf/connected-services-terms-use.pdf and Master Data Consent. Data charges may apply. Before
operating, refer to Owner’s Manual for instructions and limitations. 17. The Lane Tracing Assist (LTA) lane centering function is designed to read visible
lane markers and detect other vehicles under certain conditions. It is only operational when DRCC is engaged. See Owner's Manual for limitations. 18.
Drive Connect services may vary and are subject to change at any time without notice. Availability and accuracy depend on 4G network availability, a
cellular connection and GPS signal. Without any one or more of these things, operability may be limited or precluded. Further, if and when 4G network
changes or is discontinued, or the underlying technology required to support service becomes obsolete, then services will not work, and will need to be
discontinued.  Services  require  account  registration  through  Toyota  app  and  acceptance  of  Connected  Services  Terms  of  Use  at
toyota.com/content/dam/toyota/privacyvts/pdf/connected-services-terms-use.pdf and Master Data Consent. Data charges may apply. For Toyota’s
Connected Services’ vehicle-generated data collection, use, sharing, and retention practices and agreements, see toyota.com/support/privacy-notice/.
Trial period begins on original purchase or lease date of new vehicle. Services may vary and are subject to change without notice. Requires app
download/registration, acceptance of Terms of Use and subscription after trial (if applicable). Data charges may apply. 19. Trial period begins on original
purchase or lease date of new vehicle Services may vary and are subject to change without notice. Requires app download/registration, acceptance of
Terms of Use and subscription after trial (if applicable). Data charges may apply. 20. Do not overly rely on the Front Cross-Traffic Alert system. Always

sourcePageNotes.text:
INFO AND DISCLOSURES


1. Efficient 10-speed Automatic Transmission. Shown using visual effects. 2. Never tow beyond a vehicle’s published towing capacities. 3. Crawl Control is
designed for driving on difficult terrain at low speeds and assists the driver by controlling acceleration and braking, allowing the driver to focus on
steering. See Owner’s Manual for additional limitations. 4. The Toyota Tundra is designed to meet most off-road driving requirements, but off-roading is
inherently dangerous. Abusive use may result in bodily harm or vehicle damage. Toyota encourages responsible operation to help protect you, your
vehicle and the environment. Seatbelts should be worn at all times. Do not allow passengers to ride in cargo area. Limited CrewMax shown in Magnetic
Gray Metallic, TRD Pro CrewMax shown in Ice Cap, and 1794 Edition CrewMax shown in Midnight Black Metallic. Options shown. 5. Available i-FORCE
twin-turbo V6. 6. Never tow beyond a vehicle’s published towing capacities. Towing capacity shown is 11,350 lbs. Limited CrewMax shown in Magnetic
Gray Metallic. Options shown. 7. The Toyota Tundra is designed to meet most off-road driving requirements, but off-roading is inherently dangerous.
Abusive use may result in bodily harm or vehicle damage. Toyota encourages responsible operation to help protect you, your vehicle and the
environment. Seatbelts should be worn at all times. Do not allow passengers to ride in cargo area. TRD Pro CrewMax shown in Ice Cap. 8. TRD Pro
CrewMax interior shown in Black with Multi-Terrain Select. 9. The Toyota Tundra is designed to meet most off-road driving requirements, but off-roading
is inherently dangerous. Abusive use may result in bodily harm or vehicle damage. Toyota encourages responsible operation to help protect you, your
vehicle and the environment. Seatbelts should be worn at all times. Do not allow passengers to ride in cargo area. Payload includes the weight of

INFO AND DISCLOSURES


1. Never tow beyond a vehicle’s published towing capacities. 2. EPA-estimated 21 city/24 highway/22 combined mpg rating for 2026 Sequoia SR5 and
Limited 4x2; EPA-estimated 19 city/22 highway/20 combined mpg rating for 2025 Sequoia SR5, Limited, Platinum, 1794, TRD Pro and Capstone 4x4. Use
for comparison purposes  only. Your mileage  will vary  for many reasons, including your  vehicle’s condition and how/where you  drive. See
www.fueleconomy.gov. 3. Integrated Trailer Brake Controller is an electronic system that operates in tandem with a trailer equipped with an electric
braking system. It is designed to help the driver maintain trailer control by increasing or reducing trailer braking based on trailer weight. It is not a
substitute for safe towing practices. Factors including speed, weather, road conditions and driver input can all affect trailer braking control. See Owner's
Manual for additional limitations and details. 4. The backup camera does not provide a comprehensive view of the rear area of the vehicle/trailer. When
using straight path assist, driver should confirm clearance and is still responsible for safe operation. See Owner’s Manual for limitations. 5. Service not
available everywhere or in every vehicle. Depends on 4G cellular network availability, a cellular connection and GPS signal. Without any one or more of
these things, operability may be limited or precluded. Up to 5 devices can be supported using in-vehicle connectivity. Services may vary and are subject
to change without notice. Data charges may apply. Requires separate subscriptions to third-party provider services. Valid in the contiguous U.S. and
Alaska. Go to https://myvehicle.att.com/#/toyota/learn?language=en=US for terms and conditions. The Wi-Fi Connect trial begins at the time of
enrollment and expires the earlier of 3GB data use or the 1-month trial period ends. Trial begins at activation and expires the earlier of 3 GB data use or 1
mo. Valid in contiguous U.S. and Alaska. See https://myvehicle.att.com/#/toyota/learn?language=en=US for terms and conditions. 6. i-FORCE MAX
twin-turbo V6. 7. Capstone shown in Supersonic Red. TRD Pro shown in Ice Cap. Prototypes shown with options. 2024 models shown. 8. Never tow
beyond a vehicle’s published towing capacities. Platinum shown in Blueprint. Towing capacity shown is 9010 lbs. Prototype shown with options. 9.
Platinum interior shown. Prototype shown with options. 10. Never tow beyond a vehicle’s published towing capacities. Limited shown in Supersonic Red
with available power-extending tow mirrors. Options shown. 11. 1794 Edition interior shown in Saddle Tan. Prototype shown with options using visual
effects. 12. Wireless charging may not be compatible with all mobile phones, smart devices, tablets, e-readers, MP3/WMA players and like products. 13.
Do not exceed 120V. See Owner’s Manual for additional limitations and details. 14. Limited shown in Supersonic Red with available power-extending tow
